name: Flamingo Bay Resort
permit_info: Resort on the southern bank of the Vaal Dam at Oranjeville — access by booking. Bass & carp fishing, camping & accommodation. Contact 064 631 1513 / flamingobay01@gmail.com

name: Two Dam Sustainable
permit_info: Off-grid working farm (Langhoogte Farm) in the Keisie Valley near Montagu, with two dams for freshwater fishing. Day visits, tours & tastings, plus Kingfisher Cottages for overnight stays — all by booking. Contact 082 748 6448 / hello@twodam.co.za — www.twodam.co.za

name: Angler & Antelope Guesthouse
permit_info: TGCSA 4-star fly-fishing guesthouse in Somerset East — a base for guided fly fishing on the Great Fish River and surrounding Karoo stillwaters (smallmouth yellowfish, bass & trout). Booking required. Contact 042 243 3440 / 079 488 1361 / info@anglerandantelope.co.za — www.anglerandantelope.co.za
